verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਉਲੂ ਦਿਨ ਸਮੈ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise uloo dhin samai kaahooaai na dhekhio bhaavai taise saadh sa(n)gat mai aan dhev sevakai ||

en.bdb: Just as sight of an owl during the day is not appreciated by any body, so is a follower of a god not liked by the disciple of the True Guru in their holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਬਿਦਿਆਮਾਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਉ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kuooaa bidhiaamaan bolat na kaahoo bhaavai aan dhev sevak jau bolai aha(n)mev kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a crow cawing is not appreciated by anyone, just as a devotee of a god is not appreciated in the holy assembly of god-like True Guru. (because he may be saying haughty traits of his deity)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਟਤ ਚਟਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਹਾਇ ਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaTat chaTat savaiaan preet bipreet jaise aan dhev sevak suhai na kuTev kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a dog licks when he is patted and bites when shouted and scolded at. (both acts are not good),

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਸੋਭਤ ਨ ਬਗੁ ਠਗੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ॥੪੫੨॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maraal maal sobhat na bag Thag kaaddeeaai pakar kar aan dhev sevakai ||452||

en.bdb: Just as a heron does not fit in the group of swans and is turned out from there, so does a devotee of some god or goddess not fit into the holy assembly of God-worshipping saints. Such fake devotees should be turned out from these assemblies.  (452)
